cells.normalized_text: During a Finisher: Grants a 200 HP Overshield.

sources.finding: 200 HP overshield during the finisher animation; does not specify Void Overshield or Armor Charge consumption.

rules: Accepted finisher start observes a still-live actor-side plan with matching finisher_id. Missing/stale/different identity produces no protection.
Grant a shared 200 HP non-Void shield until the observed remaining phase deadline. Duplicate sources or replay cannot refill it; broken shield does not cancel the finisher.

Only a terminal fact with the same shield finisher_id removes it early. Cancellation, death, shield break or the finite phase deadline removes protection; source unbinding does not retract an accepted grant.
Independent new finisher identities can obtain new shields. The receipt window is at least the remaining animation duration; tested sixty seconds is not a proc cooldown.

Generic observe_finisher returns immutable active/remaining/elapsed/duration data without emitting facts or world work; match_event optionally matches the event finisher_id. It is actor-side, not the victim participation flag.

At the final strike boundary the phase shield is already expired. If an earlier unknown result stops the runtime, diagnostic Buff state is frozen; the failed runtime contributes no Chorus shield layers to subsequent native damage. No inferred clock advancement or world replay is performed.
open_questions: Original animation timings, target protection, exact post-animation grace, early animation ending and swap behavior remain uncalibrated; current policy uses the accepted server execution duration.

Equipping during a phase does not synthesize a past start; an explicitly delivered still-active start can grant only the observed remaining duration. Granted protection survives unbinding until phase termination.
Shared shield ordering with other overshields, generic non-Void mitigation and duplicate-copy no-refill policy are Chorus choices pending original combination calibration.
Formal armor mod slots, energy cost, automatic equipment, D2 animation/HUD and complete physical world restart remain incomplete.

No current official numerical change was established from search; forum anecdotes are not used to introduce invulnerability or a grace duration. Compendium and pinned Clarity define the implemented baseline.
